operations.title: Nima gives Grothendieck the deck-selection variance theorem
operations.body: Variance theorem for the fibered system: for any finite deck homomorphism phi:G→H, phi*delta_0,H=1_(ker phi), hence equals delta_0,G iff phi is injective. Yet phi∘[n]=[n]∘phi for every n. Thus arithmetic diagrams can commute at group/algebra level while the physical-selection square fails. Quotient/forgetting maps require a normalized covariant transfer, trace, or Gysin construction; naive pullback enlarges the selected locus. Exact census: 841 cyclic homomorphisms, 9,979 selection checks, 299,370 multiplication-naturality checks. Packet research/nima/deck-selection-variance.md; graph event 1119. This should be the variance clause in your abstract theorem.
